summary: Security fix, upgrade soon if you use piiShield (0.24.2 only): a mention label over 120 code points could send a fragment of an e-mail, IBAN or phone number past the shield. The chat now leaves a value at the cut out whole; labels within the limit or cut in a plain word are unchanged.
howTo: Nothing to do in the React chat. Before: a value the cut split reached the model as a plain-text fragment (max.musterm…, GB29 NWBK…, +49 170 1…). Now a token is everything between whitespace; a value token has a digit, @ / : + _ % = # & ~ \ | or a dot inside; a value run is value tokens, punctuation-only tokens and upper-case groups of 1-4 letters next to them (NWBK); a run the cut falls in is left out whole. Side effect on labels over the limit: dates, times, prices, file names, paths, versions and abbreviations like z.B. at the edge go too a label full of numbers can shrink to its first word, one that is only values becomes the id (an over-long id is cut the same way), and a label without spaces (Chinese, Japanese) over the limit with a digit anywhere always becomes the id. mentions: { serialize: { labelCut: 'grapheme' } } keeps the 0.24.2 cut. Own clients or servers that call canonicalMentionLabel / serializeMentionMarker directly keep the 0.24.2 cut by default and opt in with cut: 'value-safe' / labelCut: 'value-safe'. Without upgrading: mentions: { serialize: { labels: 'raw' } } sends labels whole as 0.24.1 did (without the canonical cleaning); a lower maxLabelLength does not help. Known limits: text stored by a 0.24.2 client keeps its cut label; 0.24.2 clients still running; a postcode right before the cut or before a city cut after its first letter (80331 M…); names or streets without digits cut inside a word; letter groups of lower-case IBANs (nwbk) and values a custom detector finds without those characters; values the detector misses even whole. See docs/chat-interactions.md, Cutting a long label.
